scores.evidence: Depends on: Phase 2 retrieval proven, because grounding quality can't be judged until the right context arrives.
scores.rationale: Each phase names its dependency and gates on an exit check (harness before retrieval, retrieval before model, single-turn before memory).

scores.evidence: Deployed: Through CI (GitHub Actions or similar) to the real prod environment via Terraform. Internal-only route, secrets in a secrets manager.
scores.rationale: Phase 0 is a real end-to-end cited answer in prod with tracing and metrics, before any features.

scores.evidence: Hosted API... | A contract requires data residency the provider can't meet, or monthly LLM spend passes the cost of self-hosting
scores.rationale: A table of irreversible decisions each with a default and a concrete flip condition, plus up-front assumptions.

scores.evidence: Answer contract... The UI, evals, logging and handoff all read this, so it's the most expensive thing to change later.
scores.rationale: Tasks are labeled widest first in every phase, with reasons: contract, then data contract, then provider abstraction, then rollout controls.

scores.evidence: Phase 0 | Staff-only behind SSO. Secrets in a manager. System prompt kept separate from user and doc text. Public articles only.
scores.rationale: The per-phase table gives concrete security measures in every phase 0–6, starting from the skeleton.

scores.evidence: An OpenTelemetry trace per request, with `retrieve` and `llm` spans. Metrics for latency, input and output tokens, cost per request and error rate.
scores.rationale: Phase 0 has traces, metrics, a dashboard and an alert, and every later phase adds specific observability.

scores.evidence: Idempotent ingestion. Full rebuild from source gives the same chunk IDs. Embedding model pinned.
scores.rationale: Reproducibility is concrete in every phase: Terraform and pinned images, versioned golden sets, pinned model snapshots, config-held flags and thresholds.

scores.evidence: 20 s timeout. If the LLM fails, show related article links and "contact support". Health check.
scores.rationale: Each phase has concrete failure handling, from the timeout and fallback in Phase 0 through DLQ, circuit breaker, Redis-loss fallback, kill switch and router default.

scores.evidence: Depends on: the Phase 1 eval harness, because recall can't be proven without it.
scores.rationale: Defenses, budgets and human handoff come in Phase 1, then retrieval, model access, memory and orchestration, then routing and feedback, exactly in the required order.

scores.evidence: Account actions and tools (order lookup, refunds). *Pull forward when* the top unresolved request types are actions and human approval for writes is proven.
scores.rationale: A dedicated deferred section lists each item with its own pull-forward condition.

note: Exceptionally complete plan: every dimension is backed by concrete content, and the AI layers are in the correct order.
